newsitem.title: USA: BPA lowers Wednesday peak, firm power $0.50/MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA lowers Wednesday peak, firm power $0.50/MWh.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) lowered firm peak power prices for Wednesday by 50 cents per megawatt hour (MWh), the agency said Tuesday.
BPA still offered 300 megawatts of firm peak power, but lowered prices to $14.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest sales and $15.50 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Prices for non-firm power during shoulder hours on Tuesday (0600, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200 PST) were unchanged at $11.00 for Northwest and $12.00 for COB.
Prices for firm and non-firm power during off-peak hours on Tuesday were unchanged at $9.00 per MWh for all deliveries.
